==Aftermath and impact==
The orcs returned to the Barrens and settled on the eastern coast establishing [[Durotar]] and its capital city, [[Orgrimmar]].

The remnants from [[Lordaeron]], human, high elves and dwarves returned to [[Dustwallow Marsh]] and built the port city [[Theramore]].

The night elves - [[Ashenvale]], [[Teldrassil]].
